clips.title: The story
paras: In southern Darkshore, hostile stone golems overrun a dig site, and Archaeologist Hollee seeks help in Auberdine. She fears for Prospector Remtravel, her senior colleague, whose research often blinds him to mortal danger.

Archaeologist Hollee crossed the sea with the Explorers' League, sent by Master Greywhisker to apprentice under Prospector Remtravel. His discoveries had made him renowned in Ironforge's academic circles. The League sent him to study ancient ruins along Darkshore's untamed coast. As the pair excavated what seemed to be the remains of a great civilization, violent stone golems burst from the earth and overran the site.

Hollee fled in panic through the night to Auberdine, the night elf port, to seek help. Remtravel barely noticed the danger. Absorbed in the relics he had uncovered, the elderly prospector stayed among the rubble while lumbering constructs surrounded his camp. South of Auberdine, anyone who reaches him finds him grumbling about missing stone brushes and misplaced fossils.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What an honor it was when Master Greywhisker assigned me to work under the guidance of the great Prospector Remtravel. At the academy in Ironforge everyone knew of Remtravel's great discoveries.
But the prospector is rather... Um... Oblivious...to his surroundings.
We had uncovered evidence of a great society. Horrible golems sprang forth from the ground and overran the site. Remtravel never seemed to notice. I ran back to Auberdine for help.
Please travel south and see if the prospector is ok!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hollee, is that you? I need some help chiseling this stone. Hand me my stone brush, I think I see something.
Hey, you're not Hollee! Don't suppose you've seen my stone brush?
Never mind that now! I promised the League I'd send the mysterious fossil I found. Where did Hollee go?
So much work to be done! Now where is that mysterious fossil... And my brush... And Hollee...
And who are you... 'tis no matter, so long as you're here to help.
Let me know when you're ready to start looking.
